sources.title: Immigration and Visa Information
sources.officialityEvidence: The live central Government visitor page identifies its entry conditions and links Gambia Immigration Department (GID) as the further visa-information authority. Its broad UK/EU/Commonwealth/ECOWAS/reciprocal guidance does not directly name any scoped passport.
sources.supportingExcerpt: other nations with a reciprocal visa exemption agreement with The Gambia do not require a visa

sources.title: Gambia Immigration Department: Visa
sources.officialityEvidence: The central Government page links GID for visa information. GID's live nationality schedule names its visa, clearance and exemption cohorts; its official WordPress API records this page modified 31 October 2025. The source is retained at medium confidence because this environment requires bypassing GID's incomplete TLS chain.
sources.supportingExcerpt: Tunisia Indonesia Russia Australia United Kingdom Czech Republic

sources.title: Gambia Immigration Department: Entry Requirements
sources.officialityEvidence: The central Government page identifies GID as the visa-information authority. GID's live entry-requirements page distinguishes approved entry clearance before travel from immigration-officer issuance at gazetted ports; its official WordPress API records modification on 31 October 2025. The environment requires bypassing GID's incomplete TLS chain.
sources.supportingExcerpt: should have a copy of the approved entry clearance valid for 30 days for entry into the Gambia

conflicts.explanation: GID's same current named schedule lists Indonesia in both its visa-exemption-agreement cohort and clearance-only Asian cohort. Central Government guidance does not resolve the direct conflict, and clearance is approval before travel rather than a visa-free status.
